verdict.rationale: Raygun's external-access-token docs list 'Sending dSYMS to Raygun' and 'Uploading ProGuard mapping files' as supported services, so the iOS and Android parts of the story are covered. That is the only mention, and nothing shows native debug symbol upload. Missing for 10: native debug symbol (e.g., Breakpad/PDB/ELF) upload, in-depth docs on the dSYM and ProGuard upload workflows, evidence that crashes resolve to function names and line numbers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
